function.name: logApplicantInfo
function.description: Save a CDL applicant in Zoho Recruit and request a 15-minute recruiter callback.

readiness.description: When the caller can start work. Pick the closest answer: 'within 3 days' for today, tomorrow, right now, or any start up to 3 days away; 'within 7 days' for this week, next week, or any start up to one week away; 'within 14 days' for any start up to two weeks away; 'later' for more than two weeks away. If the answer is unclear or conditional, ask one short follow-up question before choosing.

experience.description: Exact commercial truck driving experience stated by the caller, using a numeric amount and unit. Preserve the magnitude and never collapse it into a broad bucket. Examples: 'a little over five years' becomes '5+ years'; 'eighteen months' becomes '18 months'; no experience becomes '0 years'.

phoneNumber.description: US or Canadian callback phone number.

preferredCallbackTime.description: Requested callback date and time in ISO 8601 format, interpreted in Pacific time when no offset is supplied.
